composition_subtypes.role: maintain frequency counts of elements in sliding window
efficiently retrieve max element with frequency exactly 1

payload.core_composition_summary: Combines hash map for O(1) frequency updates with a lazy-deletion min-heap on negated values to track the maximum unique element in a sliding window.
payload.rationale: Two distinct data structures work in tandem: a hash map tracks counts, while a priority queue lazily maintains the max element with count 1. Both are integral to the solution's efficiency.
